items.title: 63520_Ernie Fields oral history interview
items.q: Yes. Sugar Lou and Eddie. Both of them sang and they had a five or six piece band

ctx.x: Yes. Sugar Lou and Eddie. Both of them sang and they had a five or six piece band and so this guy said, ask him, I don't work no bands and don't pay them, and he did. He somehow got money. He said I can kind of see how you all feel and I said, goodness, we don't have to go through that, and so we came back home to Tulsa and were playing around there.
By the way, where was Sugar Lou--
